// ===== 1. Table + seed rows ==========================================
.create table semantic_catalog (
    node_id:string, name:string, business_name:string,
    description:string, emb:dynamic
)

.ingest inline into table semantic_catalog <|
canonical:reporting.USP_ED_Sepsis,reporting.USP_ED_Sepsis,ED Sepsis Screening,"Measures pediatric patients under 21 days old presenting to the emergency department with valid sepsis screening scores and recorded blood pressure measurements.",
canonical:reports.USP_Severe_Sepsis,reports.USP_Severe_Sepsis,Severe Sepsis Episodes,"Reports management timelines of unique severe sepsis episodes, including arrival times and care event metrics.",
transform:reporting.USP_ED_Sepsis:ED_Readmit,Base_Pop_ED_Readmit,,"Patient encounters readmitted to the emergency department within 24 hours of a prior visit.",
transform:reporting.USP_ED_Sepsis:BPA,BPA,,"Timeline of clinical alerts and actions taken for each patient encounter, detailing alert statuses and overridden comments.",
canonical:reporting.USP_IP_SepsisDates,reporting.USP_IP_SepsisDates,Sepsis Reporting Calendar,"A filtered list of fiscal dates relevant to sepsis cases within a specified date range.",

// ===== 2. Embed the rows (one-time; writes emb) ======================
// Uses YOUR identity via ";impersonate" — needs prereq 0b + 0c.
.set-or-replace semantic_catalog <|
    semantic_catalog
    | extend combined = strcat(name, " | ", coalesce(business_name, ""), " | ", description)
    | evaluate ai_embeddings(combined,
        'https://aivia.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/text-embedding-3-small/embeddings?api-version=2024-06-01;impersonate')
    | project node_id, name, business_name, description, emb = embedding

// Storage optimization (optional but documented best practice):
.alter column semantic_catalog.emb policy encoding type='Vector16'

print t = "hello"
| evaluate ai_embeddings(t, 'https://aivia.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/text-embedding-3-small/embeddings?api-version=2024-06-01;impersonate')
| getschema

.set-or-replace semantic_catalog <|
    semantic_catalog
    | extend combined = strcat(name, " | ", coalesce(business_name, ""), " | ", description)
    | evaluate ai_embeddings(combined,
        'https://aivia.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/text-embedding-3-small/embeddings?api-version=2024-06-01;impersonate')
    | project node_id, name, business_name, description, emb = combined_embeddings


// ===== 3. Verify the search works when YOU run it ====================
// (If this fails, stop — the problem is setup, not the agent. A callout
// or 403 error here means prereq 0b or 0c, not a platform verdict.)
let q = toscalar(
    print t = "patients who came back to the ER"
    | evaluate ai_embeddings(t,
        'https://aivia.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/text-embedding-3-small/embeddings?api-version=2024-06-01;impersonate')
    | project t_embeddings);
semantic_catalog
| extend similarity = series_cosine_similarity(q, emb)
| top 3 by similarity desc
| project node_id, name, business_name, similarity
// Expect Base_Pop_ED_Readmit first, similarity ~0.5; others ~0.37.
